{{Quote|Look ma'am, this medical frigate just took on six thousand casualties from the Imperial attack on the planet Shackel. Everyone's got a friend on board.|[[Unnamed orderly (Mercy)|An orderly]] to [[Jan Ors]]|<ref name="RAAD" />}}
'''Shackel'''<ref name="Appendix">{{GalaxyMapAppendix}}</ref> was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was devastated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
Once the planet had cities of [[Glass/Legends|glass]].<ref name="RA">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref>

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]] the planet suffered an [[Attack on Shackel|attack]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="RAAD">[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Rebel Agent'' audio drama]]</ref> one of the many during the recent [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. After the event, its plains were seen from orbit as heat-fused earth, into which merged the glass rubble that once were its cities.<ref name="RA" />

Soon, a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] fleet consisting of the [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] ''[[Mercy (hospital ship)|Mercy]]'', an antiquated [[Battleship/Legends|Dreadnaught]] (possibly the ''[[New Hope]]''), two [[Assault Frigate Mark I|Assault Frigate]]s, a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] [[Gunship/Legends|gun ships]] and other support vessels came to its vicinity.<ref name="RA" /> The ''Mercy'' received six thousand wounded, overwhelming its wards, corridors and medical staff.<ref name="RAAD" /><ref name="RA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Shackel was first mentioned in the [[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|audio adaption]] of the novella ''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]'', which was released in [[1997]]. As the planet's name is only given in spoken dialogue from the audio adaption, the spelling could not be determined<ref name="RAAD" /> until [[2025]], when the "[[Star Systems of the Galaxy]]" appendix of star systems introduced the [[Shackel system]] to the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]].<ref name="Appendix" />

In the novella the planet and the attack are not mentioned; however, the ''Mercy'' is seen orbiting an unnamed, recently devastated, planet, strongly suggesting that the casualties seen on board are from there. This article treats them as the same planet. It is also possible that the unnamed planet is [[Milagro/Legends|Milagro]], which appears in the sequel novella ''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]'', described as having ruined cities of molten glass and crystal after some attack.
